svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Four residuals vs fitted patterns
svg.desc: Four residual plots, each with a dashed zero line and an orange smoothing line. A random band with a flat smoothing line means the model fits. A U-shaped curve means a missing term. A funnel that widens to the right means unequal variance. One red point far above the rest is an outlier.
